heading: Glimmerfrost Ward
text:
Glimmerfrost Ward

Evocation [Cold] Level: Sor/Wiz 2 Components: V, S Casting Time: 1 standard action Range: Personal Target: You Duration: 1 round/level Saving Throw: None Spell Resistance: No

A shimmering lattice of frost wraps the caster, chilling anything that draws near.
